newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU continues probe into Thomson aid.
newsitem.headline: EU continues probe into Thomson aid.

text.p: The European Commission will continue its investigation into the proposed recapitalisation of Thomson SA, despite the suspension of the sale of the electronics and defence giant, a Commission source said on Wednesday.
But it was unlikely to give its verdict on December 18, as originally expected, the source told reporters.
"The Commission must assess the aid aspect. That is separate from the sale," the source said.
EU competition officials held a meeting with French Treasury officials and Thomson representatives on the issue on Monday.
The French government had agreed at the meeting to provide written commitments and assurances regarding the injection of 10.8 billion francs ($2 billion) into Thomson, the source said.

"The major part" of the money was intended for Thomson Multimedia which was set to be sold to Daewoo Electronics of South Korea before the operation was cancelled by a French privatisation commission.

The source hinted that as the case stood on Monday, the EU would probably have taken a favourable approach to the capital injection, which amounts to state aid, if the French government provided necessary commitments. ($ = 5.270 French Francs)
